description: Synthetic two-mass suspension verification bench. Not measured truck data; no full-vehicle or tire calibration claim.

sprung_mass_kg.source: RCV-04a synthetic numerical test mass; not a weighed vehicle corner

unsprung_mass_kg.source: RCV-04a synthetic numerical test mass; not a measured wheel assembly

suspension_stiffness_n_per_m.source: RCV-04a synthetic linear wheel-rate test parameter; not shock stiffness or a motion-ratio conversion

tire_stiffness_n_per_m.source: RCV-04a synthetic unilateral normal spring; not a calibrated RC tire
